headlines.title: Jamie Dimon Warns AI Agents That Make Payments on Your Behalf ‘May Not’ Act Properly: AI Revolution Like a ‘Tsunami’ That Must Be Managed
headlines.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) CEO Jamie Dimon cautioned that artificial intelligence agents allowed to make payments for customers would need their bank codes, putting the agents inside the bank with no assurance that they will act in customers’ interests.

headlines.title: JPMorgan, Goldman Boost Yield on Volta AI Loan to Lure Investors
headlines.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. hiked the yield and sweetened terms on a $5 billion leveraged loan sale for Volta Infrastructure Holdings Ltd. as investors demand greater compensation to buy risky debt tied to the artificial intelligence boom.

headlines.title: JPMorgan's Chicago Office Renovation Costing Bank Over $800M, Dimon Says
headlines.summary: JPMorgan announced the renovation in February 2024, but at the time, it declined to disclose a full cost estimate for the major overhaul of the building.

headlines.title: Jamie Dimon Sees 'Higher Chance' of Market Trouble Than Wall Street Does — ‘That Is Not a Prediction,’ but JPMorgan Is Preparing for the Risk
headlines.summary: JP Morgan Chase & Co.‘s CEO Jamie Dimon said he still sees a greater chance of a market shock than most people do, while the bank saw revenue increase by 8% year over year to $50.

headlines.title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Misses Third Quarter Earnings, Is The Upside Already Priced In?
headlines.summary: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) has just paired a rare third quarter earnings miss with an active funding push, issuing a series of callable unsecured notes alongside reporting US$15.3b in quarterly net income. The third quarter earnings miss and wave of new bond issuance hit a stock that has already cooled off recently, with a 30 day share price return of 4.24% and a 90 day share price return of 2.29% even as the shares are still up 3.01% year to date. At a share price of US$335.

description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. operates as a bank and financial holding company in the United States, rest of North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, Latin America, and the Caribbean. It operates in three segments: Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management. The company offers deposit, investment and lending products, and cash management; mortgage origination and servicing activities; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and credit cards, payment solutions, travel services, merchant offers, lifestyle benefits, auto loans, and leases to consumers and small businesses through bank branches, ATMs, and digital and telephone banking. It also provides investment banking, market-making, financing, custody, and securities products and services; corporate strategy and structure advisory, equity and debt market capital-raising, and loan origination and syndication services; cash and derivative instruments, risk management solutions, prime brokerage, clearing, and research; and fund services, liquidity and trading services, and data solutions products for large corporations, financial institutions, merchants, start-ups, small and midsized companies, local governments, municipalities, nonprofits, and commercial real estate clients. In addition, the company offers multi-asset investment management solutions in equities, fixed income, alternatives, and money market funds to institutional clients and retail investors; retirement products and services, estate planning, lending, deposits, and investment management products to high-net-worth clients; and financial transaction processing. JPMorgan Chase & Co. was founded in 1799 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
